calls.summary: Marcus Delgado called to schedule a demo of Intermedia Unite for his 40-person accounting firm. Agent Oscar walked him through per-user pricing, the softphone app, and AI meeting recaps. Marcus booked a live demo for the following week and asked for a follow-up quote.

Priya Nair reached out about the Intermedia Contact Center with AI Agent Assist for her growing support team. Agent Lila explained omni-channel routing and sentiment insights, then confirmed seat pricing. Priya scheduled a demo and requested the CCaaS buyer's guide by email.

Derek Olsen asked about migrating his on-prem PBX to the cloud and whether SIP trunking could keep his existing handsets. Agent Mary outlined the migration path and toll-free provisioning, and answered his number-porting questions. Derek scheduled a demo to see the setup live.

Rachel Kim, a new prospect opening a second office, called to set up service and see Intermedia Unite in action. Agent Rosey collected her company details, user count, and preferred contact info, then confirmed her business phone system requirements. Rachel scheduled a new demo for her leadership team.

Tomás Rivera wanted to move his team from a legacy provider to hosted Exchange email and a Microsoft 365 plan with Intermedia support. Agent Lee reviewed mailbox pricing and provisioning timelines. Tomás booked a demo to review the migration process.

Angela Foster called to check the shipping status of the desk phones ordered for her new branch. Agent Sue located the order and confirmed a delivery window within a few business days. Angela was satisfied but did not need any new service.

Brian Whitaker asked how to add five more users to his existing SecuriSync file backup plan. Agent Mike explained the seat change and the version-restore feature. Brian said he would confirm the addition with his office manager first.

Nina Alvarez inquired about the AI Receptionist to handle after-hours calls for her clinic. Agent Jennifer described automated routing and FAQ handling, then answered her privacy questions. Nina scheduled a demo to hear the AI answering flow.

Kevin Park reported that his SIP trunking setup was not registering after a config change. Agent Rose gathered the trunk details and confirmed the gateway settings needed to be updated. She opened a support ticket and set a callback for the technician.

Sharon Bell disputed a charge on her latest invoice for extra Microsoft 365 licenses she did not recall adding. Agent Lee reviewed the billing history and found two seats provisioned in error. He submitted a credit request for the next cycle.
Ray Coleman called after hours and the line rolled to voicemail. He left a message about a delayed number port and asked for an urgent callback. No agent was available to take the call.

Greg Sanders wanted a warranty replacement for a desk phone that kept powering off. Agent Sue verified the device was under coverage and started an RMA. Greg was frustrated by the return shipping wait but accepted the timeline.

Denise Carter called to request cancellation of eight Contact Center seats after a team downsizing. Agent Mike reviewed the contract terms and explained the notice period. Denise was unhappy about the remaining commitment and asked to escalate.

Paul Nguyen complained about repeated dropped calls and poor voice quality on his cloud phone system. Agent Rose ran a line check and suspected a local network issue. Paul was irritated that the problem had recurred and demanded a resolution date.

Laura Simmons called about a billing error and threatened to cancel her entire account over repeated overcharges. Agent Jennifer apologized, reviewed the invoice, and found a duplicate line item. Laura remained dissatisfied and asked for a manager callback.

prompts.question: Is the customer trying to solve a specific problem?
prompts.answer: The caller runs a 15-person marketing agency and needs to replace their legacy PBX system with a cloud-based solution that includes team chat, HD video conferencing, and AI call insights to support remote and hybrid work.

prompts.question: What are the customer's expectations?
prompts.answer: They expect a unified platform that consolidates phone, chat, and video in one product with modern AI capabilities, minimal setup time, and straightforward per-user monthly pricing that scales with team size.

prompts.question: How could the agent handle the call better?
prompts.answer: The agent should have confirmed the email address verbally and ensured it was recorded in the CRM before ending the call. Restating the exact demo date and time would also have reduced any booking confusion.

transcript.text: Good afternoon and thank you for calling Intermedia Communications. This is Marcus with the sales team. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus. Yes, I'm looking for a new business phone system for my company. We're currently on an older on-premises PBX and it's just not cutting it anymore.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I appreciate you calling in. I'd love to help. First, may I have your name please?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Of course. It's Jennifer Chen.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Jennifer, wonderful. So you're looking to move to a cloud-based phone system. Can you tell me a bit about your company? How many people are on your team?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sure. We have about 15 employees. We're a marketing and digital advertising agency based here in Portland, Oregon. We really need something that can support remote work and give us better collaboration features.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's perfect. A 15-person agency is a great fit for our Intermedia Unite platform. It brings together calling, video conferencing, team chat, and file sharing all in one place. Plus, we have AI-powered features that can help with customer insights and call summaries. Can you tell me, what is your current provider, and are you in the Portland area?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: We're still using an older Avaya system. Yes, we're in Portland, downtown actually. Our ZIP code is 97201.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent. Portland is definitely in our service area. Now I'd like to get some contact information from you so we can set up a personalized demo. What's the best phone number to reach you?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect. And what about your email address for the demo confirmation?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Oh, just send it through to my work address. You can look that up if you need it from the company directory.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Okay, I'll make a note of that. I have you down for a demo next Wednesday at 2 PM with our sales engineer. They'll walk you through Intermedia Unite and show you how the team chat and video features can benefit your remote team. Does that time work for you, Jennifer?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Wednesday at 2 PM works great. Thank you so much.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome, Jennifer. We look forward to connecting with you and showing you the future of unified communications. Have a wonderful day.

callDetail.aiSummary: Jennifer Chen, a marketing agency owner in Portland with 15 employees, called to explore transitioning from a legacy Avaya PBX to a cloud-based unified communications platform. Marcus qualified her for Intermedia Unite, confirmed Portland service availability, and successfully scheduled a demo for Wednesday at 2 PM. The call was well-structured with proper greeting and close, but the email address was not explicitly captured in the CRM and the demo appointment details were not verbally confirmed with full clarity.

comment.author: Kyle Paklaian
comment.text: @Marcus great job walking Jennifer through our Intermedia Unite value prop and getting her to commit to the demo. Your qualifying questions about company size and current provider were spot-on. Two coaching points for next time: (1) ask for and record the email address directly rather than leaving it for a directory lookup, and (2) confirm the demo date and time one more time at the very end so there's zero ambiguity. These small touches reduce no-shows and show professionalism. Well done overall.

qaPairs.question: What is Intermedia Unite?
qaPairs.answer: Intermedia Unite is our all-in-one UCaaS suite that brings business phone, video, chat, and file sharing together with AI that keeps your team in sync. The best way to see it in action is a quick virtual demo, would you like me to set one up?

qaPairs.question: How much does a business phone system cost?
qaPairs.answer: Pricing depends on your number of users and the features you need, so we build a custom quote rather than a fixed list price. I can schedule a demo with a solutions specialist who will give you exact numbers for your team.

qaPairs.question: Do you support businesses moving from an on-prem PBX?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we specialize in migrating businesses from on-prem PBX hardware to our cloud platform, and SIP trunking is available if you want to keep existing equipment. Let's book a demo so a specialist can map out your migration.

qaPairs.question: Can I keep my current phone numbers?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, you can port your existing business numbers to Intermedia and we handle the process for you. A specialist can walk through the porting timeline during a quick demo.

qaPairs.question: What is the Intermedia Contact Center?
qaPairs.answer: Our Intelligent Contact Center is a CCaaS solution where AI surfaces sentiment, captures details, and guides next steps across voice and digital channels. I can arrange a demo so you can see the agent and supervisor tools live.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer Microsoft 365?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we provide licensed Microsoft 365 with Intermedia support and provisioning, plus add-ons like Copilot, backup, and email protection. A demo is the best way to review the right bundle for your team.

qaPairs.question: What is the AI Receptionist?
qaPairs.answer: The AI Receptionist automatically answers calls, routes them, and handles common FAQs so no caller is missed. I would be glad to schedule a demo so you can hear how it works.

qaPairs.question: Do you provide video conferencing?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, AnyMeeting offers HD video meetings, screen sharing, and webinars with AI meeting recaps, and it is included with Intermedia Unite. Want me to book a demo so you can try it?

qaPairs.question: Can I send business text messages from my company number?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Team Chat and SMS lets you send business SMS from your company number alongside persistent team messaging. Let's set up a demo so you can see the full messaging experience.

qaPairs.question: How does Intermedia use AI across its platform?
qaPairs.answer: Intermedia Intelligent Communications turns everyday calls, chats, and meetings into clarity and better decisions using AI unified in one platform. A demo will show you the AI features that fit your business best.

qaPairs.question: Do you have solutions for healthcare?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we offer vertical solution sets for healthcare along with automotive, education, legal, financial services, and retail. I can schedule a demo tailored to your industry.

qaPairs.question: What is SecuriSync?
qaPairs.answer: SecuriSync provides cloud file backup, sync, and secure sharing with version restore. A specialist can show you how it protects your files during a quick demo.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer email archiving for compliance?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Intermedia Archiving protects your communications data and uses AI to help you learn from it, supporting compliance needs. Let's book a demo to review your retention requirements.

qaPairs.question: How reliable is your support?
qaPairs.answer: Intermedia has been recognized by J.D. Power for an Outstanding Customer Service Experience for nine consecutive years. I can schedule a demo where you can ask a specialist anything about support.

qaPairs.question: Do you work with partners and resellers?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we support a large channel of MSPs, VARs, and carriers, with over 7,500 partners, plus white-label options. I can connect you with our partner team through a scheduled demo.

qaPairs.question: How many users do I need to get started?
qaPairs.answer: We serve businesses of many sizes, from small teams to mid-sized companies, and pricing scales per user. Tell me your team size and I will set up a demo with an accurate quote.

qaPairs.question: What is Copilot for Microsoft 365?
qaPairs.answer: Copilot is an AI assistant embedded across Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams to speed up everyday work. A demo will show how it fits alongside your Intermedia services.

qaPairs.question: Can you back up Microsoft 365 data?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Backup for Microsoft 365 automatically backs up and restores mail, files, and SharePoint data. Let's book a demo so a specialist can review your data protection needs.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer toll-free numbers?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we provision toll-free numbers and offer SIP trunking with metered calling. I can schedule a demo to confirm the right calling plan for you.

qaPairs.question: How do I get a quote?
qaPairs.answer: Because we build custom per-user quotes, the fastest way is a short virtual demo where a specialist reviews your needs and prices them exactly. Would you like me to find a time that works for you?
